description: This file defines the SetCookie class within the GuzzleHttp","Cookie namespace. It provides methods to create, manipulate, and validate HTTP cookie objects, representing individual Set-Cookie headers in HTTP responses.

classes.name: SetCookie
classes.description: Represents an HTTP Set-Cookie header as a PHP object, allowing creation, manipulation, and validation of cookie data according to RFC 6265 standards.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a SetCookie object from a Set-Cookie header string, parsing its key-value pairs and cookie attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SetCookie object with optional data array, setting default attribute values and computing expiration time if necessary.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Serializes the SetCookie object back into a properly formatted Set-Cookie header string.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the cookie data as an associative array.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the cookie's name.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the cookie's name.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the cookie's value.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the cookie's value.

methods.name: getDomain
methods.description: Returns the cookie's domain.

methods.name: setDomain
methods.description: Sets the cookie's domain.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the cookie's path.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the cookie's path.

methods.name: getMaxAge
methods.description: Returns the Max-Age attribute of the cookie.

methods.name: setMaxAge
methods.description: Sets the Max-Age of the cookie.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Returns the expiration time of the cookie.

methods.name: setExpires
methods.description: Sets the expiration time of the cookie.

methods.name: getSecure
methods.description: Indicates whether the cookie is marked as secure.

methods.name: setSecure
methods.description: Marks the cookie as secure or not.

methods.name: getDiscard
methods.description: Returns whether the cookie is a discard/session cookie.

methods.name: setDiscard
methods.description: Marks the cookie as discard or not.

methods.name: getHttpOnly
methods.description: Indicates whether the cookie has the HttpOnly attribute.

methods.name: setHttpOnly
methods.description: Marks the cookie as HttpOnly or not.

methods.name: matchesPath
methods.description: Checks if a given request path matches the cookie's path.

methods.name: matchesDomain
methods.description: Checks if a given domain matches the cookie's domain.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is expired based on the current time.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the cookie's name, value, and domain according to RFC 6265, returning true if valid or an error message if invalid.
